title: Predictors of rheumatic fever in sore throat patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: Multiple databases were searched to identify cohort, case–control, cross-sectional or randomised controlled trials that measured RF incidence in ST patients.
adjudication.k_quote: Seven studies with a total of 6890 participants were included: three RCTs and four observational studies.
adjudication.reason: Prognostic risk-factor review pooling mixed designs; no RCT-only pairwise intervention synthesis.
